instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the missing word.

atoms.a: He says it’s really important to be informed about current affairs.
atoms.b: He says it’s really important to be informed about ((current)) affairs.

atoms.a: I still embarrass myself every time I try to play dodgeball.
atoms.b: I still ((embarrass)) myself every time I try to play dodgeball.

atoms.a: I know that when I’m doing my homework, every text message will interrupt my concentration, but I still check my phone anyway.
atoms.b: I know that when I’m doing my homework, every text message will ((interrupt)) my concentration, but I still check my phone anyway.

atoms.a: Do you want to join our school committee?
atoms.b: Do you want to join our school ((committee))?

atoms.a: If you want to become a professional athlete, you have to commit a lot of your time to training.
atoms.b: If you want to become a professional athlete, you have to ((commit)) a lot of your time to training.

parentBlock.title: Spelling Practice (13) - current, embarrass, interrupt, irresistible, committee, commit
